title: Joint Optimization of SKINNY Tweakey Injection
summary: The paper optimizes SKINNY's tweakey permutation alone; jointly choosing that permutation and the eight injected tweakey nibbles for related-tweakey resistance remains open.

formal_statement.body: In $\mathrm{SKINNY}$, $\operatorname{AddRoundTweakey}$ XORs into the state the eight tweakey-word nibbles in the first two rows. The unresolved task is to optimize resistance to related-tweakey attacks jointly over the tweakey permutation $\mathrm{PT}$ and the choice of which eight tweakey-word nibbles $\operatorname{AddRoundTweakey}$ XORs into the state, rather than fixing the latter to the first two rows.

scope.domain: Joint tweakey-schedule design for the SKINNY block cipher against related-tweakey attacks.
parameters: Eight selected tweakey-word nibbles: the AddRoundTweakey inputs XORed into the state
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine a joint choice of PT and eight injected tweakey-word nibbles that optimizes resistance to related-tweakey attacks.

citations.label: How to Use Metaheuristics for Design of Symmetric-Key Primitives

progress.summary: The paper presents joint optimization of PT and AddRoundTweakey as a potential future direction after optimizing PT alone; it reports no joint solution.
citation_labels: Ivica Nikolic et al., How to Use Metaheuristics for Design of Symmetric-Key Primitives
